newsitem.title: UK: LME copper prices hold above support in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LME copper prices hold above support in late trade.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) copper prices edged slightly lower during the evening session but by 1900 GMT remained above the key $2,080 support.
Prices had burst through $2,100 earlier on the back of a lower than forecast stock increase of only 2,875 tonnes versus expectations of as much as 12,000 tonnes coming into warehouses.
At 1900 GMT copper was quoted at $2,085/$2,088 against an afternoon kerb close of $2,095, up $14. It traded in a range of $2,077 to $2,118.
But traders were wary and broker Rudolf Wolff said in a commentary any confirmed breach of the $2,080 level would target $2,000 based on a head and shoulders pattern.
Any move above $2,100 would find resistance at $2,150.
Nickel added lightly to earlier gains to be indicated at $6,590/$6,620 after a kerb close of $6,575, up $65 and the other markets were virtually unchanged.
